title: Fun Sushi Making Class at a Local Brewery in Minneapolis

All ingredients and cooking tools provided.
Expert instruction, tips and chef secrets you’ll use daily.
An authentic experience hosted at a local public brewery, distillery, craft beer bar or wine bar.
requirements: This cooking class is designed to accommodate a variety of dietary needs! Please let us know in advance, and we'll do our best to tailor the experience to suit your preferences and restrictions.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Trade your usual brewery snacks for freshly rolled sushi in this fun, hands-on cooking class with Chef Pao.

Hosted at a local brewery, this interactive experience teaches you how to create two restaurant-style sushi rolls from scratch. Begin with the crowd-pleasing California roll, packed with imitation crab, cucumber and avocado. Next, prepare a flavourful spicy salmon roll with fresh salmon, crunchy vegetables and a creamy kick of spice.

You’ll learn how to handle sushi rice, arrange your fillings and roll everything neatly using professional techniques shared by Chef Pao. After class, enjoy your handmade sushi and pair it with a drink available for purchase from the brewery.

Perfect for beginners, food lovers, date nights or anyone who believes sushi tastes even better when you make it yourself.
